bookmarks.name: Kiểm tra tiền công phép (TP)
bookmarks.sql:
* Thay bangluong bang ten bang luong cua thang, CONGCHEDO bang cot (hay so) cong che do cua don vi.
* Ket qua 0: cong thuc dung. Khac 0: tab Thong bao dua san cau SELECT liet ke cac dong lech.
USE bangluong
SUM TP-LC*HSDC*2700000*DIEMP/9.8*CP/CONGCHEDO*HSL

bookmarks.sql:
* Thay bangluong bang ten bang luong cua thang, CONGCHEDO bang cot (hay so) cong che do cua don vi.
* Ket qua 0: cong thuc dung. Khac 0: tab Thong bao dua san cau SELECT liet ke cac dong lech.
USE bangluong
SUM TCD-LC*HSDC*2700000*CD/26*0.35*HSTN

bookmarks.name: Kiểm tra tiền lương khuyến khích (THUONG)

* Ket qua 0: cong thuc dung. Khac 0: tab Thong bao dua san cau SELECT liet ke cac dong lech.
USE bangluong
SUM THUONG-LC*HSDC*DIEM*(CONGCHEDO-CO-CTD-CDE)/CONGCHEDO*HSTG
